name: At the Heart of Blackberry Manor
source:
Atop a hill stands a lone manor, surrounded by bramble and obscured by fog.

You’ve only called it home for little to over a month now, but you've already grown awfully bored of it. There's only so many ways a lady can entertain herself, after all.

Moreover, your sole companion is a courteous yet enigmatic physician who's unlikely to open up his heart to you just yet. He has been entrusted with your recovery and you've led a fairly uneventful life ever since coming to his manor.

However, the more you explore its grounds, the more oddities you encounter and the more you come to realise that the whole place is shrouded in mystery.

You’ve yet to uncover all of its secrets, including its owner, but can you discover what truly lies at the heart of Blackberry Manor before your departure?

[From [url=https://wispy-wisteria.itch.io/at-the-heart-of-blackberry-manor]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
山顶上有一座孤独的庄园，四周荆棘丛生，雾气缭绕。

你才把它称为家一个多月，但你已经对它感到非常厌倦了。毕竟，女士们娱乐自己的方式就这么多。

此外，你唯一的同伴是一位彬彬有礼但神秘的医生，他目前不太可能向你敞开心扉。他把你的康复托付给了你，自从你来到他的庄园之后，你就过着相当平静的生活。

然而，你探索的越多，你遇到的怪事就越多，你就越会意识到整个地方笼罩在神秘之中。

你尚未揭开它的所有秘密，包括它的主人，但你能在出发前发现黑莓庄园的核心到底是什么吗？

[来自[url=https://wispy-wisteria.itch.io/at-the-heart-of-blackberry-manor]itch.io[/url]]
